facts.value: External blocking N-FET Q1: source to IN_SYS, drain to IN, gate to B_GATE (back-to-back with the internal FET). Pulldown signal FET Q2 across B_GATE, DRV and IN_SYS; Q2 must be at least 15 V VDS, 20 V VGS maximum rating, Ciss <= 50 pF and VGTH(min) <= 3 V.
facts.conditions: Required for reverse polarity protection and reverse current blocking; without it IN_SYS and IN are shorted and B_GATE/DRV left open. RCB comparator V(REVTH) -20/-15/-9 mV; tRCB(dly) 0.48/3 us typ/max at 10 mV overdrive.
